name: Deguchi Shirou
source:
Likes: Cooking, muscle training, espresso
Skills: making curry, roasting coffee, fighting
Role: manager of Cafe EXIT

A man who works as the manager of Cafe EXIT in the New World. At a glance he doesn't seem like the typical coffee shop proprietor, but it is said that once he receives an order he can prepare it with no mistakes and with precise skill, and that he can make first-rate curry, so his ability as the manager is undeniable.

[Translated from [url=http://oreowa.jp/character/deguchi.html]the official site[/url]]
